text:
alex: Hey team — need someone to press prod for release v3.2.1 (pinned). Change window 23:00-23:30 UTC tonight. Can someone with prod deploy perms take this? Release notes: small streaming middleware bugfix that reduces p99 by ~0.3s. cc @marta for the last-minute schema tweak.

marta: I can do it but i'm not in the prod-deploy group yet, and MFA enrollment for my account didn't finish.

sam: We shouldn't add people to the press group right before a window. Options: oncall can JIT-grant, or do a limited canary then full press by an existing deployer.

deploy-bot: preflight checks running... PRELIGHT FAILED: service-account 'deployer-main' key rotation mismatch (last rotated 2024-09-12). See ops/keys for details.

marta: If JIT works i'll take it. how do i request the grant?

lia: Security — do not add permanent perms for a hot window. Use JIT: run `grant-deploy marta --expires 01:00` in the admin console. Approval required from oncall. Note: if the SA key is expired we will still block full rollout; canary may be allowed.

oncall-rotation: i can approve a 1h JIT for marta. post justification pls.

alex: Justification: urgent customer-facing latency regression from streaming middleware. Fix reduces p99 and is low risk. Canary + monitoring in place. Alex.

oncall-rotation: :thumbsup: approved. @security-bot please issue JIT token.

security-bot: JIT token issued to marta, expires 01:00 UTC. Audit ID: 0xabc123. NOTE: SA key rotation still required before allowing full-pressure roll if any canary shows infra-level errors.

sam: Plan: start with canary `redwood deploy --canary=10 --version=v3.2.1` -> monitor 15m -> full. If p99 > 2s or error rate > 0.5% rollback immediately.

marta: starting canary in ~2m. ping me to trigger rollback if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: canary started: id=c-1769123456, target=10% of traffic, endpoint=/generate. Log: `INFO deploy canary started`.

marta: ~10m in — canary stable. p50=0.12s p95=0.60s p99=1.10s errors unchanged.

alex: looks good to me. proceed to full, i'll post release notes in #announcements after push.

marta: pressing full now (using JIT token).

deploy-bot: full rollout initiated. version pinned -> v3.2.1 deployed to 100%.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK helper available: `deploy-bot revert c-1769123456` (callable until 23:45 UTC).

sam: monitor will auto-bail on regressions and fallback to v3.1.9 per rollback policy.

marta: all green from metrics and traces. closing the change window early. thanks all. :tada:

security-bot: AUDIT: user=marta used JIT token (ID=0xabc123) to deploy v3.2.1. MFA status: enrolled post-deploy. Action items: rotate deployer-main SA key within 24h (#ops), and follow up with permanent group membership review.
